desc: SpeedSafe ambidextrous assisted opening system. With SpeedSafe, you can smoothly and easily deploy the blade with one hand, either left or right. Leeks come in a wide variety of handle styles, some with technologically advanced coatings for enhanced performance. From simple bead-blasted stainless steel to "smoked" aluminum to a wide array of colors, you'll find a Leek that's the perfect everyday carrying knife for you. All Leeks include a safety tip-lock and a reversible/removable pocket clip.
